sources.title: Mistral Small 3.2 model documentation
sources.evidence: Identifies Mistral Small 3.2 v25.06 as mistral-small-2506; dates model June 20, 2025; displays Apache 2.0, 128k context and function calling. Now marked deprecated, with Small 4 as replacement.

sources.title: Pinned official Mistral Small 3.2 documentation data
sources.evidence: Exact model/API mapping and linked 3.2-24B-Instruct-2506 checkpoint. The weights row separately states parameters 24 and active 24; model type Open, license Apache 2.0, input text/image, output text, function calling, 128k context and June 20 release. Documents April 30, 2026 deprecation and July 31 retirement.

sources.title: Pinned official model weights table renderer
sources.evidence: Labels the weights parameters and active columns in billions, establishing the units of the separate 24 and 24 disclosures.

sources.title: Mistral official changelog
sources.evidence: Under June 20, 2025 records release of Mistral Small 3.2; under June 23 separately records availability of its mistral-small-2506 API. These are different milestones, not conflicting model dates.

sources.title: Mistral Small 3.2 24B Instruct 2506 model card
sources.evidence: Official checkpoint card identifies this as a minor Small 3.1 update, reports improvements in instruction following, repetition and function calling, declares Apache-2.0, and demonstrates text/image input, text responses and tool calls. Serving examples use 131072. Retrieved live card and matched official repository revision.

sources.title: Pinned Mistral Small 3.2 Transformers configuration
sources.evidence: Mistral3ForConditionalGeneration with dense Mistral text configuration: 40 layers, hidden size 5120, MLP size 32768, 32 query/8 KV heads. Pixtral vision configuration has 24 layers. max_position_embeddings is 131072; dtype BF16.

sources.title: Pinned Mistral Small 3.2 native configuration
sources.evidence: Native params independently specifies 40 text layers, hidden dimension 5120, feed-forward width 32768, 32 query/8 KV heads, 24-layer vision encoder and max_position_embeddings 131072.

sources.title: Pinned Mistral Small 3.2 weight index
sources.evidence: Public BF16 checkpoint index lists 585 tensors with shared per-layer attention projections and dense gate/up/down MLP weights, plus vision encoder and multimodal projector; no expert/router tensors. Metadata total_size is 48022722560 bytes. Only metadata/configuration read; no weight shards downloaded.

sources.title: Pinned mistral-common chat template documentation source
sources.evidence: The exact checkpoint is explicitly described as "mistralai/Mistral-Small-3.2-24B-Instruct-2506 (non-reasoning)" while contrasting Magistral-Small-2506. Mistral warns tokenizer identity cannot reliably detect thinking support. This is affirmative exact-model evidence for the dedicated-reasoning flag.

sources.title: Mistral Small family legal lifecycle
sources.evidence: Groups versions 3.0, 3.1 and 3.2 in the Small family and explicitly lists Small 3.2 as an open-source update released June 20, 2025. Lifecycle status here differs from API retirement metadata; it is not evidence that the endpoint remains operational.

name.note: Exact official name for v25.06 and the dated API ID; distinct from Small 3.1 and Small 4.

developer.note: Mistral AI publishes the documentation and checkpoint; retain the catalog developer label Mistral.

family.note: Official Small model line; normalized catalog family retained.

release_date.note: Retain the first public model/checkpoint release, as the record describes the open-weight Small 3.2 model as well as its API alias. The official changelog separately dates mistral-small-2506 API availability June 23, 2025; June 20 is not the API launch date.

open_weights.note: Official Open model listing links a public checkpoint with readable configuration and weight index; no gated access or shard download was needed.

license.note: Both official documentation and exact checkpoint card declare Apache 2.0.

parameters_b.note: Developer nominal model-level total in billions. Use the explicit 24B disclosure, not storage bytes as an exact learned-parameter census.

active_parameters_b.note: Mistral separately publishes active=24 in an Active (B) column for this exact checkpoint. This is its nominal model-level active count, not an inferred equality from density or an independently measured per-token count.

architecture.note: Dense Transformer text decoder with grouped-query attention, Pixtral vision encoder and projector. Exact configuration and checkpoint keys establish shared MLPs and attention in each layer rather than expert routing.

context_window.note: Exact native maximum in both official configurations is 131072; documentation advertises the rounded label 128k. No reviewed primary evidence establishes a distinct exact 128000 API cap. This value describes model capacity, not verified current endpoint availability.

modalities.note: Explicit documented modalities agree with exact-checkpoint multimodal configuration and examples.

reasoning.note: Mistral explicitly labels the exact checkpoint "non-reasoning" in its chat-template source. The flag concerns dedicated thinking support; it does not deny ordinary reasoning or the card example headed vision reasoning.

tool_call.note: Function calling is explicitly listed and demonstrated for this revision.

description.value: Mistral Small 3.2 is a 24B dense multimodal instruction model with improved instruction following, reduced repetition, and function calling.
description.note: Replace generic speed/extraction/production-assistant claims with model-specific supported identity, architecture and stated improvements.

patch.notes: 24B total and 24B active are separate nominal disclosures in Mistral's official model table, not an inferred per-token census. Dense multimodal Transformer; native context is 131072 tokens, advertised as 128k. June 20, 2025 is the public Small 3.2 model release; the mistral-small-2506 API became available June 23. Dedicated reasoning is explicitly unsupported for this checkpoint. Official documentation records API retirement July 31, 2026; specifications here do not establish current endpoint operation.

summary: Verified all 14 fields from exact first-party model metadata, checkpoint files and explicit non-reasoning documentation. Add Apache-2.0, nominal 24B total/24B active, dense architecture and native 131072 context; replace generic description. Retain June 20 first model release with explicit June 23 API-availability distinction. No weight shards downloaded; only this report written.
